$comment: The race chapter: one race drawn kilometre by kilometre. splits are per-km times (m:ss) and should add up to the PR time. Notes appear when the marker passes `at` (0..1). Set placeholder to false once the splits and notes are real.

notes.title: Start
notes.text: Went out controlled on purpose. The first kilometre always feels too easy, and that's the trap.

notes.title: Settle
notes.text: Found a group running my pace and tucked in. Nothing clever here, just even splits and steady breathing.

notes.title: Halfway
notes.text: Through halfway on schedule. This is where a 5K starts to hurt, and where it is really decided.

notes.title: Last kilometre
notes.text: The final kilometre was the fastest of the day. Sub-3:55, everything left on the road.
